Method of Attack: Exploitation of CVE-2017-11882 vulnerability in Microsoft Office and Wordpad RTF attachments to execute multiple scripts (VBScript, PowerShell, PHP, others) that download and execute payloads; Backdoor installation and persistence via scheduled task; Payload downloaded from Pastebin executing PowerShell commands to save base64 encoded executable
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with Microsoft Office and Wordpad vulnerable to CVE-2017-11882
Attack Vector: Malicious RTF document attachments exploiting CVE-2017-11882 vulnerability
